page.running_head: ODI ODO OFF OG OLD OLE

main_text.p: ODIVM μῖσος, est tanta cordis atque affectus nostri auersio à persona proximi, vt ne vultum quidem eius iam ferre, & iucundè intueri possimus, propter iniuriæ nobis illatæ recordationem.

ODIVM proximi prohibetur, Leuit.19.17. Prou.15.17. Matt. 5.v.23.24. 1 Ioan.2.v.9.11.& 3.15. & 4.20. Odium rixas generat, Prou.10.12. Odium malì præcipitur. Ps.97.10.& 139.21. Amos 5.15.& 6.8. Rom.12.9. Odium Christi quàm exitiale, Ioan.15.23. Odium Euangelij causa, Matth.10.22. Marc.13.13. Luc.21.17. Ioan.16.2. Odium reprobationis nota & signum, 1 Ioan.3.13. Odij exempla: Abimelech & socij eius, Gen.26.27. Esau, 27.41. Chananæi, 34.30. Fratres Ioseph, 37.v.4.5. Ægypti, Exo.1.12. Madianitæ, Num.25.v.17.18. Israelitæ, Iudi.11.v.6.7. cæci & claudi, 2 Sam.5.8. Amnô, 13.v.15.22. Razon, &c.1 Reg.11.25. Achab, 22.8. Hostes Iudæ, 1 Eldr.4.1. Aman, Esth.7.6. Hostes Dauidis, Ps.18.18.& 25.19.& 44.8.& 69.v.5.15. Iudæi, Amos 5.10. Mundus, Ioan.7.7.& 15.18. Vide DISSENSIO.
ODORATVR Deus sacrificium pii, Gen.8.21. [1 Sam.26.19.] Equus bellum, Iob. 39.28. Idola nihil adorantur, Deuter.4.28.
OFFENDICVLA necesse est venire, Matth.18.7. Vide HAERESES. Offendiculum fratri non obiiciendum, Rom.14.13. sine offendiculo sit Christianus, 1 Corinth. 9.12. Vide Scandalum.
OFFENSIONES vitandæ, & quomodo, Rom.3.8.& 6.v.1.14.& 16.17. 1 Cor.9.22. 2 Tim.2.19. 1 Cor.10.32. 2 Cor.6.3.

OFFERENDVM Deo, non Dæmonibus, Leu.17.7. offerendam non est hostia vitiosa, Deut.17.1. offerendarum pecudum armentorum, &c. titus, Leuit.1.1 &c. ¶ Offerendum esse pro defunctis, contendunt Pontificij ex 2.Mach.12.13.
OFFICIVM subditorum, (Vide SVBDITI.) & aliorum V suis locis.
OG, Rex Basan, Israeli cum valido exercitu se opponit. Num.21.33. vincitur, v.35. & cæditur, v.33. Deut.3.3. eius lectus ferreus, v.11. (. panis subcinericius.)
OLEVM lapidi à Iacobo extructo suffunditur, Genes.28.18. & 35.14. Oleum Tabernaculi lucernæ. Exod.27.20. olei v

page.notes: Right margin shows only cropped text from the facing page, left out. Greek in OdiVM entry ("μῖσος") is partly obscured by the printed symbol and is uncertain. The final line is cut off at the right edge of the column ("olei v"). The word "fu" at lower right is taken as a catchword.
